title: ScoreBreakdown
description: A session's score, computed by backend/scoring from stored runs and events only (no LLM). Stored in scores.breakdown and shown on the report. Holds counts and rates only: no test names, output or other hidden-test data. The same stored records always give the same breakdown.

scoring_version.description: Version of the formulas in backend/scoring that produced this breakdown.

final_score.description: Novice: mean correctness. Adept/Master: 0.8 × mean correctness + 20 × ai_efficiency.

ai_efficiency.description: AI efficiency E (Adept/Master). Null for Novice, which has no assistant.

tasks.description: One entry per task, in task order.

visible.description: Visible tests passed in the submission.

hidden.description: Hidden tests passed in the submission.

visible_rate.description: Share of the counted visible tests that pass: the fail_to_pass ones when rates_over is fail_to_pass, else all. Null when there are none; its weight then goes to the hidden rate.

hidden_rate.description: Same as visible_rate, for the hidden tests.

perf_budget_ms.description: The task's time budget. Null when the task has no perf constraint.

perf_ms.description: Measured runtime on the perf input. Null when there is no perf constraint or nothing was measured.

perf_factor.description: 1.0 within budget, linear down to 0.5 at 3× budget, 0.5 beyond.

time_ms.description: First focus to last edit on this task. Null without a focus or an edit event.

runs.description: Runs of this task during the session.

rates_over.description: fail_to_pass: the rates count only the tests that fail on the starter (TaskSpec.fail_to_pass), SWE-bench style. all_tests: every test counts; DSA tasks (every case is something to solve) and domain tasks stored without fail_to_pass ids. Absent in breakdowns stored before scoring v2.

visible_f2p.description: Visible fail_to_pass tests passed in the submission. Null unless rates_over is fail_to_pass.

hidden_f2p.description: Same as visible_f2p, for the hidden tests.

pass_to_pass.description: pass_to_pass tests (visible + hidden) still passing in the submission. Null unless rates_over is fail_to_pass.

regression_factor.description: Share of pass_to_pass tests that still pass: breaking working code costs points. 1.0 without pass_to_pass tests or when rates_over is all_tests.

mutation_score.description: The task certificate's mutation score: how well the task's tests catch bugs. Shown on the report, never affects the score. Null when not measured; absent in breakdowns stored before P2.7.
